classification.difficultyReason: Read intersections on supplied graphs and select the inside or outside intervals, including or excluding endpoints according to the inequality.

content.prompt: Solve these inequalities. A graphical representation is given.

spec.description: Un gridded Cartesian axes, integer ticks, blue absolute-value graph and red horizontal comparison line.
spec.mathematics: y=|x| and y=2; x ticks -7 to 7 excluding zero; y ticks 1 to 7.
spec.answerVisibility: Graphs are permanent givens; solution intervals appear only in answers.

answer.worked: The blue graph is on or below the red line between the intersections at $x=-2$ and $x=2$. Thus $-2\le x\le 2$.

spec.description: Cartesian axes with integer ticks; blue V and red horizontal line, all with endpoint arrows.
spec.mathematics: y=|x| and y=5; x ticks -7 to 7 excluding zero; y ticks 1 to 7.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent supplied graph; no solution marks.

answer.worked: The blue graph is above the red line to the left of $x=-5$ and to the right of $x=5$. Thus $x<-5$ or $x>5$.

spec.description: Cartesian axes with integer ticks; blue V and red comparison line.
spec.mathematics: y=|x| and y=3; x ticks -7 to 7 excluding zero; y ticks 1 to 7.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent supplied graph; no solution marks.

answer.worked: The blue graph is below the red line between $x=-3$ and $x=3$. The intersections are excluded, so $-3<x<3$.

spec.description: Cartesian axes with integer ticks; shifted blue V and red comparison line.
spec.mathematics: y=|x-1| and y=2; vertex (1,0); x ticks -7 to 7 excluding zero; y ticks 1 to 7.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent supplied graph; no solution marks.

answer.worked: The blue graph is below the red line between the intersections at $x=-1$ and $x=3$. Thus $-1<x<3$.

spec.description: Cartesian axes with integer ticks; shifted blue V and red comparison line.
spec.mathematics: y=|x-2| and y=4; vertex (2,0); x ticks -7 to 7 excluding zero; y ticks 1 to 7.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent supplied graph; no solution marks.

answer.worked: The blue graph is on or above the red line when $x\le -2$ or $x\ge 6$.

spec.description: Cartesian axes with integer ticks; shifted blue V and red comparison line.
spec.mathematics: y=|x+1| and y=3; vertex (-1,0); x ticks -7 to 7 excluding zero; y ticks 1 to 7.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent supplied graph; no solution marks.

answer.worked: The blue graph is above the red line when $x<-4$ or $x>2$. The intersections are excluded.
